Class Offscreen

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.Offscreen
public class Offscreen extends Object
Forge entry point forwarding lifecycle events to the appropriate physical side.

The common/server proxy avoids loading client rendering classes. Forge injects a client proxy only in a client process. Cleanroom is required; ModularUI and HEI appear as load-order hints, not mandatory dependencies.
